cases.name: A screen status presents the resolved screen, its greeting rendered from the responses, with empty diagnostics inside it
A screen status with no responses hides the greeting and reports its condition in the diagnostics inside the screen
A screen status collapses a container to its winner, carries the winning button's writes through, and reports a variable the context lacks
The root is read for context and responses only: a third root key renders nothing and its path is reported missing
A waiting status is presented as the state alone
A done status is presented as the state alone
A waiting status whose info carries a reason and a retry hint presents both beside the state
A waiting status whose info carries only a reason presents the reason and no retry hint
A waiting status whose info carries only a retry hint of zero presents the hint and no reason
A waiting status whose info carries neither key is presented as the state alone, and a key beside the two is not read
A waiting status whose info is not an object is an error
A waiting status whose info is null is an error
A waiting status whose info is an array is an error
A waiting status whose reason is not a string is an error
A waiting status whose reason is null is an error
A waiting status whose retry hint is below zero is an error
A waiting status whose retry hint is not an integer is an error
A waiting status whose retry hint is a string is an error
A screen status naming a key the document does not declare is an error, not an empty screen
A status outside screen, waiting and done is an error
